proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: base change to T; closed immersions are affine (morphisms lemma) so h^*i_*G' = i_{T,*}(h')^*G' by the cohomology base-change lemma; then a chain of identifications: Hom on X_T, pushforward adjunction (middle equality, adjointness of i_{T,*} and i_T^*), pullback compatibility (h')^*i^* = i_T^*h^*, giving Hom(i^*F, G')(T) (source lines 621-647)
